decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Reasons for Refusal

1.	The proposed terraced unit comprising three two-bedroom dwellings, by means of their orientation, would not be sufficiently separated from the habitable rooms on the rear elevation of the dwelling at 78 Main Street, resulting in a loss of privacy, which would be detrimental to the living conditions of both the prospective occupiers of the proposed units and the occupants of 78 Main Street.  The proposal is therefore contrary with policy H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003 and the Council's Supplementary Planning Guidance.

2.	The proposed terraced units would not be provided with suitably sized private amenity areas, to the detriment of the living conditions of its prospective occupiers and is therefore contrary with policy H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003 and the Council's Supplementary Planning Guidance.

3.	The proposed development does not provide any on-site car parking facilities, which is not an acceptable design feature and would be likely lead to increased congestion and be detrimental to the free and safe flow of traffic in the immediate locality, which is contrary with policies T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) and T.4.3 (Traffic Implications of New Development) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.
description: Erection of three x 2 bed terrace houses fronting Fir Road in rear garden of existing house.
